$description: Apollo theme registry (ADR-0011). One baseline library, four themes as override sets at the semantic tier. Mono = base; Legacy = populated override; Console + Supercharge = declared nullable slots (ADR-0010). This file is the single source of truth for which colour belongs to which theme, consumed by _validate_theme_provenance.py.

apollo-legacy.label: Apollo Legacy
apollo-legacy.role: Retained for legacy interfaces; superseded over time, never deleted.

ownsHexes.#DB0011: Legacy brand red — primary CTA, tabs/active, progress/complete, rag/error (dark)

stateMechanism.$note: Legacy = faithful reproduction (R-D24): states carry as-built explicit values, no operational fades (R-D23: tabs mechanism none — bar-only differentiation).

apollo-mono.label: Apollo Mono
apollo-mono.role: ★ The baseline built now — 'very mono': monochrome throughout, colour ONLY in RAG status + dataviz.

ownsHexes.#B92F1E: Mono's only red — RAG breach + dataviz loss ONLY (R-D19, R-D7/R-D14). Never action/nav.

apollo-mono.declaredSlotsNote: Dave 2026-07-21: declare null placeholder slots on Mono NOW for anticipated flex (the input error-condition colour especially) so a value can be added any time — per-theme or in Mono itself — without re-architecting (ADR-0010 declared-but-unset). Declared HERE (registry), not in the live store: the ADR-0010 §3 no-null-under-live-binding gate is still staged, so nulls do not enter semantic-colour.json until it is built. Namespace finalised at population time.

stateMechanism.$note: ADR-0014/ADR-0009: states render via operational alpha, stored colour = the ramp-snapped equivalent. Snap ramp = neutralRamp.

apollo-console.label: Apollo Console
apollo-console.role: Branded HSBC library (was Apollo UI). Sibling of Mono (ADR-0014, LOCKED 2026-07-22): shares Mono's neutral ramp, interaction-opacity values, status/RAG and dataviz — fenced below. Its broader branded CHROMATIC palette sits on top, parked. Live divergence NOW: rounded corners.

stateMechanism.$note: Sibling of Mono — SAME opacity values, same snap ramp (color/mono/1-15). Fenced.

fencedPaths.$note: ADR-0014 sibling fence (enforced by gen_theme_cascade --selftest): Console's override set may not touch these prefixes — divergence here would break the {mono,console} DNA. Ruled FIRM 2026-07-22.

apollo-supercharge.label: Apollo Supercharge
apollo-supercharge.role: Brand-uplift rework. Carries its OWN warm neutral ramp (color/warm/*, Figma pull 2026-07-22) via the neutral DNA tier; status/RAG + dataviz identical to Mono. Sibling of Legacy (ADR-0014).

stateMechanism.$note: ADR-0014: hued neutral ramp — a fade drags hue off-ramp, so states are COLOUR by default; opacity permissible only where the composite is engineered to snap to a color/warm step (the snap gate checks against the active theme's neutralRamp).

notes.resolution: resolve(role, mode, theme): theme override wins; else base (Mono). Components stay theme-blind.
notes.cascade: Rendered by canon/gen_theme_cascade.py into canon.css (AUTO-THEMES block): [data-apollo-theme="<attr>"] root-level canonical vars + per-component vars via each snippet's #token-manifest; dark values on the [data-apollo-theme][data-theme=dark] combo (and descendant form). Mono = base, no block emitted. Divergence axes are theme-overridable, NEVER hardcoded (Dave 2026-07-21): colour, neutral ramp, shape/border-radius, anticipated input error-condition.
notes.gate: A Mono-designated surface (see _STYLE-PROVENANCE.md) must not resolve to, or hardcode, another theme's ownsHexes.
notes.backlog: tabs/active and progress/complete need a Mono value ruled (R-D19) before their Legacy red can be gate-seeded as blocking.
notes.neutralRamp: ADR-0014: neutralRamp is LOAD-BEARING — it is the snap target for the state mechanism (_validate_state_snap.py) and the membership scale for a theme's neutral resolutions. The DNA tier color/neutral/1-15 aliases mono in the base; a theme rebinds neutral/* onto its own ramp (supercharge -> color/warm/*). Legacy stays explicit-per-path (reproduction, R-D24 posture) and does not ride the DNA tier.

siblingPairs.$note: ADR-0014 spine (Dave 2026-07-22): all four themes share one flexible root DNA — 'at any point we could engineer 3 to align completely to one we choose.' Pairs: {mono, console} share neutral ramp, interaction-opacity values, status palette and dataviz (console FENCED from diverging — ruled FIRM: 'lets lock this in, they should be the same'); {legacy, supercharge} are structural siblings with different palettes.
